report_comment.text: BRD3 encodes bromodomain-containing protein 3. NUTM1 encodes NUT family member 1. BRD3::NUTM1 is an alternative NUT carcinoma fusion, retaining BRD3 chromatin-associated regions and the NUTM1 carboxy-terminal region. Patients with this fusion were included in the molecularly annotated NUT carcinoma cohort. In a retrospective NUT carcinoma cohort, nonthoracic BRD3/NSD3-fused tumors had better survival than nonthoracic BRD4-fused tumors; thoracic site remained an adverse feature.
